title: Connecting and Cutting
intro: Connected stones share liberties. A gap between your stones may let the opponent split them into separate groups.

steps.explanation: They now form one group and share all their liberties.

steps.instruction: You are White. Play between the black stones to cut them apart.
steps.hint: Exactly where you would have connected.
steps.explanation: White occupies the point that Black needed to connect. The black stones remain separate groups.

steps.instruction: Keep White from splitting Black. Connect the stones.
steps.explanation: Black is now connected. White cannot play in the joining point.

outro: Look for connecting points in your own groups and cutting points in your opponent's.
